study type: Systematic review of randomized controlled trials and cohort studies
exposure: Treatment group (glyburide vs. insulin, metformin vs. insulin)
cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes
finding: Glyburide and metformin appear to be safe and effective alternatives to insulin for managing blood glucose in patients with gestational diabetes who prefer not to use insulin or cannot afford it.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences in preterm deliveries, delivery modes, macrosomia, and birth weights and large for gestational age when utilizing glyburide vs insulin for gestational diabetes management.
birth_weight: Reported but no specific values provided
